name: k10-chain
about: Library mods chained (abi draft 3 addition 2, lumakit rule 8): k10-chain calls k10mid's twice, which calls k10inner's times_million through its own kind 6 import. twice(3) gives 6000000 back across both. twice(5000) overflows inside k10inner (S0904), and the report is k10-chain's, at main.lum line 15, because each export passes the first caller and its place through. That frame's run ends, so `after` is never logged
